name: Stack Exchange API
summary: Questions, answers, tags and users across Stack Overflow and 170+ Q&A sites.
description: Read API for all public content of the Stack Exchange network including Stack Overflow: questions, answers, comments, tags, users, badges, and full-text search. Supports filters to choose returned fields.

auth.notes: Optional free key from stackapps.com raises the daily quota from 300 to 10,000.

rate_limit.summary: 300 requests/day per IP without key; 10,000/day with a free key; max 30 req/s; response includes quota_remaining

example.response_excerpt:
{
 "items": [
  {
   "title": "Why is conditional processing of a sorted array faster than of an unsorted array?",
   "score": 27548,
   "tags": [
    "java",
    "c++",
    "performance",
    "cpu-architecture",
    "branch-prediction"
   ],
   "view_count": 2023462
  }
...

agent_notes: The site parameter is required on almost every call (e.g. site=stackoverflow). Responses are always gzip and include quota_remaining; register a free key at stackapps.com to raise the daily limit to 10,000.
caveats: 'site' param required on most calls. Attribution required (CC BY-SA).
